objective: Connect Skills Index discovery and actual skill invocation to independently verified Utility Ledger outcomes, then persist bounded inactive review candidates without mutating active or third-party skills.

baseline.skills_index: Active and quarantined skills are searchable, but searches, selections, and invocations do not share one durable receipt chain.
baseline.utility: The Utility Ledger records independently verified task utility and execution economics without a first-class skill-use identity.
baseline.skill_foundry: Verified Skill Evolution accepts repeated workflow receipts and detects decay, but does not derive minimal review notes or revisions from actual indexed-skill use.
baseline.third_party: Quarantine and promotion protect third-party skills, but outcome-derived improvements do not have a dedicated overlay or upstream-PR candidate artifact.

hard_boundaries: Search-only evidence is discoverability-only and cannot satisfy efficacy gates.
Verified outcomes must resolve against the persisted Utility Ledger and the same agent session.
Training and holdout usage identities and sessions must be disjoint.
Notes and revisions require exact matched-control lift and no material retry, failure, latency, or cost regression.
Every decision binds the recorded skill digest to the current native Skills Index source.
Novelty and fixed line and estimated-token budgets fail closed.
Third-party improvements remain inactive local-overlay or upstream-PR candidates.

No review operation installs, activates, edits, exports, deactivates, retires, invokes a model, runs a subprocess, or performs a network call; its only filesystem mutation is the owner-only review ledger write.

holdouts: A searched-only chain must abstain and report discoverability evidence without efficacy credit.
A selected but non-invoked chain must remain efficacy-ineligible.
A skipped or stale receipt transition must fail closed.
An outcome from another project, session, agent, or unverified Utility Ledger row must fail closed.
Three exact disjoint matched controls and holdouts with positive lift may produce a bounded-note candidate.
A duplicate or oversized delta must abstain.
A holdout with positive utility but material failure, retry, latency, or cost regression must abstain.
A third-party improvement may produce only a local-overlay or upstream-PR candidate.
Retain and retirement recommendations remain inactive review records.
Replayed idempotency keys return the original receipt; conflicting material is rejected.

cost.expected_storage: bounded append-only owner-only Skill Foundry ledger rows

latency.measurement: local focused route tests plus the full gateway suite
latency.target: review derivation remains bounded by configured receipt caps and local ledger/index reads

failures.detail: The Homebrew python3.14 module environment did not include pytest. The installed canonical pytest 9.1.1 executable ran the same selected tests successfully.

The composite gate reports 495 over-budget active-user context files, including unchanged global and repository AGENTS.md files. All other composite subchecks passed; this change does not edit those files.

result.summary: The native Skills Index, agent-session ledger, Utility Ledger, and Skill Foundry now share one fail-closed usage and efficacy-review chain. Search remains discoverability-only; only independently verified, exact-source, session-bound outcomes can support an inactive review decision.
verification: Focused feature and concurrent idempotency tests passed.
Full gateway and CLI suites passed.
Generated contract drift check and contract boundary audit passed.

No operation performs provider, network, subprocess, active-skill, vendor-source, installation, activation, deactivation, or retirement mutation; each successful operation performs one explicit owner-only ledger write.
